name: StellarFoundations
author: SilentHacks
description:
Build planetary bases that stay put.

• Start a level base on timber piers
• Anchor existing builds in place
• Adjust supports up to six metres
• Keep floors, rooms and machinery

Preview: remote co-op is not yet qualified. Multiplayer needs matching versions.

Requires Demo 0.8.2, MelonLoader 0.7.3, SDModKit 1.3.3 and Sandbox Menu.
